2: To the Overseer with stringed instruments, on the octave. --A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, in Thine anger reprove me not, Nor in Thy fury chastise me.
3: Favour me, O Jehovah, for I am weak, Heal me, O Jehovah, For troubled have been my bones,
4: And my soul hath been troubled greatly, And Thou, O Jehovah, till when?
5: Turn back, O Jehovah, draw out my soul, Save me for Thy kindness' sake.
6: For there is not in death Thy memorial, In Sheol, who doth give thanks to Thee?
7: I have been weary with my sighing, I meditate through all the night on my bed, With my tear my couch I waste.
8: Old from provocation is mine eye, It is old because of all mine adversaries,
9: Turn from me all ye workers of iniquity, For Jehovah heard the voice of my weeping,
10: Jehovah hath heard my supplication, Jehovah my prayer receiveth.
11: Ashamed and troubled greatly are all mine enemies, They turn back--ashamed in a moment!
